text: DIAGNOSIS READY: Fifth Disease (Erythema Infectiosum) caused by Parvovirus B19. The combination of low-grade fever, rhinorrhea, headache, and a pruritic rash on the trunk and extremities in the context of recent viral symptoms is highly suggestive of this condition, often characterized by a "slapped cheek" appearance that may subsequently spread to the body in a lacy pattern.
